Step 3 of 3 · Review and start

    Make sure public access is off:
    https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-block-public-access.html
  ! Setup imports the last 7 days of included projects; older history is separate.
  ! Sensitive text may remain after filtering.

  ! Codex scope expands to all current and future projects (Codex only).
    New admissions start after this local consent; old history and paused or excluded starts remain out of scope.

? Start archiving?

  1) Start archiving (default)
  2) Edit a setting

  [d] Full settings and privacy
  [q] Cancel; keep draft
  [m] Name this machine

› Choose [1]:
✓ Start archiving

✓ Setup complete · Automatic capture is on
Installed /handoff, which continues a session in another agent: ~/.agents/skills/handoff/SKILL.md
Installed the agent-archive skill, which lets your agents look up and pull in past sessions: ~/.agents/skills/agent-archive/SKILL.md
To remove the agent skills and keep them off, run agent-archive setup --no-skills.

Next, in each app
  Codex: automatic discovery captures supported tasks that start from now on in
  any non-excluded current or future project; no hook approval needed.
  Optional hook capture: Codex: run /hooks and approve the archive hooks; they
  capture sessions that start after that (or after /clear).
Setup's recent import only covers explicitly included projects. Review earlier Codex sessions in other projects with agent-archive backfill --since 7d.
Check progress with agent-archive status.
  · Another machine: agent-archive machines pair

  1) Finish setup (default)
